target.name: Element shop::Order — Enter to select, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove

uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

after.properties:
- region "Class — shop__Purchase":
  - heading "Class — shop__Purchase" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Name (id)
  - textbox "Name (id)": shop__Purchase
  - text: Kind
  - combobox "Kind":
    - option "Class" [selected]
    - option "Abstract Class"
    - option "Interface"
    - option "Enum"
  - text: Stereotype (e.g. <<service>>)
  - textbox "Stereotype (e.g. <<service>>)"
  - text: Highlight color (#hex or color name)
  - textbox "Highlight color (#hex or color name)"
  - text: Texture
  - combobox "Texture":
    - option "None" [selected]
    - option "Hatched"
    - option "Crosshatch"
    - option "Dotted"
    - option "Grid"
    - option "Striped"
  - group "Members":
    - text: Members
    - combobox "Visibility":
      - option "Unspecified"
      - option "+ public" [selected]
      - option "- private"
      - option "# protected"
      - option "~ package"
    - textbox "Member text (member 1)":
      - /placeholder: "name: type   or   method(args): type"
      - text: "lines: List<Line Item>"
    - button "Delete member 1": ✕
    - checkbox "abstract"
    - text: abstract
    - checkbox "static"
    - text: static
    - button "+ Add Member"
  - button "Add teaching callout"
